view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and industrial lighting. Pallets stacked with boxes and crates line the space, supported by metal racks. Forklifts operate in the background near loading bays. The floor is concrete, showing tire marks from vehicle movement. The overall environment suggests active storage and logistics operations.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Metal shelving unit on left side, blue vertical supports with yellow protective caps at base. Holds multiple rows of cardboard boxes. Partially obstructed by pallets in front. Attached to wall via visible brackets. Appears freestanding but anchored.

objects.label: pallet with boxes
objects.observation: Wooden pallet in center foreground holding stacked cardboard boxes wrapped in plastic. Boxes have labels. Rests directly on concrete floor. Partially obscured by other pallets nearby. No visible supports beyond floor contact.

objects.label: red forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift positioned in mid-ground, facing right. Operator visible inside cab. Near stack of wooden pallets. Appears to be moving toward background loading area. Floor shows tire tracks around it.

objects.label: stacked pallets
objects.observation: Multiple wooden pallets stacked vertically against back wall, forming a tall column. Located behind forklift. Some have boxes on top. Supported by warehouse structure. Partially blocked by forklift and other pallets.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Fluorescent light fixtures suspended from ceiling. Emit bright white light. Arranged in linear pattern along ceiling. Illuminates entire warehouse. No visible mounting hardware from this angle.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Dark gray concrete surface covering entire ground area. Shows visible tire marks and scuff marks. Reflects some overhead lighting. Provides base support for all objects. No visible seams or joints.

<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s2-34930", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
